description: This file is a shell script used for testing the interaction between Git and SVN with respect to internationalization and encoding settings. It includes functions to compare commit and log outputs, sets up repositories for different encodings, and verifies that Git and SVN handle commit encoding metadata correctly.

methods.name: compare_git_head_with
methods.description: Compares the current Git HEAD commit with the expected content stored in a provided file, truncating the output to relevant lines.

methods.name: compare_svn_head_with
methods.description: Extracts the SVN log message for comparison, removing committers info and formatting differences.
